meta.title: GoodPlanCraftLauncher - A lightweight, efficient Minecraft launcher - CaelLabGameTS
meta.description: GoodPlanCraftLauncher is a simple, efficient Minecraft launcher with Microsoft and offline login, version management, and Forge/NeoForge/Fabric/OptiFine mod installation, so you can get into the blocky world in one click. Open source and free.

hero.subtitle: Lightweight · Efficient · Open source
hero.desc: A Minecraft launcher written for Windows: Microsoft and offline login, version management, and one-click Forge / Fabric / OptiFine installation. When the game crashes, it tells you why instead of just showing an empty box.
hero.windowNote: The window above is clickable — it is the launcher interface itself, running inside the web page.

features.title: Core features
features.desc: Practical tools for players, each one aimed at getting you into the game faster

items.title: Two login modes
items.desc: Microsoft and offline login, switchable at any time; offline mode needs no online verification.

items.title: Mod downloads built in
items.desc: Search Modrinth and CurseForge, then install mods, shaders or resource packs into the folder the selected version actually uses.

items.title: Four mod loaders
items.desc: Forge, NeoForge, Fabric and OptiFine install from the official sources, with the Java version checked first.

items.title: 25 interface languages
items.desc: Follows your system language on first launch; switch it any time in the settings.

items.title: Automatic version management
items.desc: Download, install, and switch Minecraft versions in one click, with libraries and assets handled automatically.

items.title: Fast startup
items.desc: A streamlined launch path and caching, so you click and play instead of waiting.

items.title: Java runtime management
items.desc: Detects and installs a Java runtime automatically; the download source can be set to Tsinghua, Nanjing University, Huawei Cloud, or the official source, falling back to the next one on failure.

items.title: Theme support
items.desc: Full light and dark mode support, with adjustable interface scaling for a consistent look.

items.title: Automatic updates and maintenance
items.desc: Built-in update checks and a configurable automatic log cleanup keep the launcher lean over time.

items.title: Crash notices and error reports
items.desc: When the game exits abnormally it explains why, and can export an error report in one click (crash report + logs + system info).

items.title: Running panel
items.desc: After launch, a panel on the right shows the version, PID, uptime, and memory use, and can end the game at any time.

items.title: Custom window title
items.desc: Write your own game window title, with magic words such as {mc_version} and {time}.

shots.title: Real screenshots

items.label: Java runtime
items.text: Installed automatically by the launcher; cleaning up redundant or conflicting Java installs on the system is recommended

items.label: Storage
items.text: At least 90 MB free for the launcher itself (game files not included)

items.label: Memory
items.text: 2 GB or more available memory recommended

openSource.title: Open source and contributions
openSource.desc: GPCL is a 100% open source project, with its source hosted on GitHub. PRs are welcome, and so are suggestions on the forum, to build a better Minecraft launcher together.
